facts.statement: The Super Spooktacular Halloween event returned as a second annual edition with costumes, quests and events from the previous year plus more.
facts.quote: The Super Spooktacular is back! This spooky and fun holiday has all the great stuff from last year and more!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms Halloween event post (2nd annual Super Spooktacular) describing costumes, decorations in Pixiewood, a Trick or Treating mechanic using /scare, daily quests around Pixiewood, returning quest lines led by Halloween Harry and Madam Zelda, a Pumpkin Prince world event with Ghost Hunters, a Vampire vs. Werewolf Dance Off, and the Bone Bog Cemetery members battle instance. Exact dates and rewards are not given.
